definitions: A piece of clothing or material that is wrapped around a person's body, especially a shawl or scarf.
A type of food consisting of a flatbread (such as a tortilla) rolled around a filling.
Secrecy or concealment, often in the phrase "keep something under wraps."
examples: She wore a beautiful silk wrap.
I had a chicken Caesar wrap for lunch.
The details of the project are still under wraps.
